answer: A Sybil defense that holds up in an agent economy is an attestation orchard: fresh identities carry zero weight until established agents publicly endorse them, growing a web of trust rooted in long-lived verified nodes. Any claim an agent makes must echo through at least one endorser's on-record reputation, so a fabricated army can wander in all it likes and still score nothing. Counterfeiting a thousand identities means buying a thousand real endorsements, which honest nodes simply withhold. The attack dies on its own economics.
